sources.entry: FHEM - Automate common tasks in the household like switching lamps and heating. It can also be used to log events like temperature or power consumption. You can control it via web or smartphone frontends, telnet or TCP/IP directly. (Source Code) GPL-3.0 Perl

summary.name: FHEM
summary.one_liner: FHEM is a Perl-based home automation server for automating household tasks such as switching lamps and heating, and for logging events like temperature or power consumption.
use_cases: control home devices from a smartphone
summary.what_it_does: ["Automates common household tasks such as switching lamps and heating.", "Logs events such as temperature or power consumption.", "Can be controlled through web or smartphone frontends.", "Can also be controlled via telnet or directly over TCP/IP.", "This page is the Trac source browser for the FHEM SVN repository, showing trunk, branches and tagged releases (latest listed release FHEM 6.5)."]
notable: Open source under GPL-3.0 with Perl source code
Multiple control interfaces: web, smartphone, telnet, TCP/IP
Combines automation with event and sensor logging
